name: Relevance of MassSpecGym mass-based retrieval, Hit rate@1 (MassSpecGym in the Wild Table 2) to "Shortlist molecular identities from tandem mass spectra"
description: MassSpecGym mass-based retrieval Hit rate@1 as evidence for shortlisting candidate structures without a known formula.

attributes.endpoint: Hit rate@1 (mean over MassSpecGym test spectra, 99.9% bootstrap CI) for ranking the true structure among mass-matched PubChem candidates
attributes.rationale: Proxy, not direct. The mass-based track withholds the formula, which matches the use case's formula-free input and shortlist endpoint. MIST here takes the top-1 formula predicted from the spectrum by a MIST-CF retrained on the MassSpecGym training split only, and that formula is not used to filter candidates (Section 4.3), so the pipeline needs only the spectrum and precursor mass. This differs from the formula-conditioned MIST the use case excludes, which receives the true formula. Only two valid configurations are measured (random ranking and this MIST pipeline), and the candidate pool and split differ from the MSAlign settings the use case was built on.
constraints: Use only the two non-grey evaluations; the grey rows leak ground-truth or test-trained formula information and are excluded.
